business: Pressure finds the weak point in a plan, agreement, or system and makes it harder to pretend the problem is manageable.
shadow: What buckles was already asking people to carry more than their share.
arcSeparating: What still works after the pressure is probably worth keeping.
base: patience runs thin for rules, expectations, or responsibilities that have been demanding too much for too long. Shortcuts stop working.
